prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram
Asset type: a single landscape industrial-design assembly explanation sheet for a detachable robot cockpit.
Primary request: Make a clear, polished product design schematic, not CAD or a manufacturing drawing, showing the user's selected faceted mecha cockpit architecture and removable assembly. IMPORTANT COLOR UPDATE: all newly printed visible shell components use ORANGE AND YELLOW ONLY: rich deep-orange main monocoque cover, brighter warm yellow bolt-on armor and trim. Do not use the old red/black body palette. Silver purchased screws and electrical contacts may retain metallic colors; the visor remains transparent smoky clear with visible transparency.
Input image 1 is a SHAPE-ONLY style reference: extract ONLY the robot's central faceted cockpit/head, its multi-faceted sloping transparent front canopy, twin narrow expressive eye elements behind the canopy, centered low camera, roof facets, and side vent arrangement. No robot legs in this sheet. Ignore image 1's colors and text.
Input image 2 is a STRUCTURAL reference for the EXISTING fixed hollow bowl hood. Preserve its recognizable rounded-square tapered hood, open bottom, two deep screw wells, central small magnetic-connector seat, and shallow raised locating rim. Recolor the fixed hood orange/yellow for this concept sheet, without inventing extra stacked mounting mechanisms.
Composition: clean off-white professional engineering presentation, accurate readable simplified Chinese labels, generous whitespace. Three clearly divided regions:
LEFT about 38%: large assembled front three-quarter view of the orange/yellow cockpit resting on the fixed hood. The cockpit keeps the reference's aggressive yet companion-like angular helmet silhouette, removable transparent front visor, yellow vent/side armor and orange main cover. Subtle warm amber eye elements; clearly physical transparent canopy, not a digital display screen.
RIGHT upper about 45%: coherent exploded assembly of THE SAME head, consistently oriented. Show ONE main hollow orange upper cover; a SEPARATE transparent faceted front visor removed a short distance forward with its slim retaining frame and small mounting screws; separate yellow left/right exterior armor trims positioned to each side with just a few actual screw callouts; a provisional flat orange head bottom carrier plate below the upper cover, attached to cover by screws; BELOW that, a distinct fixed rounded-square bowl hood. The bottom carrier belongs to the removable HEAD; the bowl hood belongs to the ROBOT CHASSIS. Do not add screws crossing the magnetic seam between head bottom plate and fixed hood. Keep exploded layers count reasonable and mechanically intelligible, no fictitious ornate machinery.
BOTTOM right inset about 22%: close-up cutaway of docking: the underside of head bottom plate contains a FEMALE recessed pocket fitting over the fixed hood's MALE shallow rounded-square locating rim, with a small positive assembly clearance. In the center show a matching pair of compact four-contact magnetic connectors, housed in recesses, the lower socket in the fixed hood and upper counterpart under the head. Use three signal wires and leave the fourth contact spare. Show simple upward separation arrow. Head removal is magnetic-only plus locating geometry: NO lock, NO latch, NO screw coupling across detachable seam. Small built-in connector magnets and gold contacts must be visually distinguishable from alignment rim. Do not show flat surfaces blocking connector mating.
Exact short Chinese labels, use only these plus numbered markers:
Title: "橙黄驾驶舱 · 装配结构示意"
"主体罩壳"
"透明面罩｜可拆"
"黄色饰件｜螺丝固定"
"头部底板｜方案待确认"
"底部配合凹槽"
"磁吸接口"
"固定碗底｜两颗原机螺丝"
"凹凸定位＋磁吸"
Footer: "结构概念示意 · 非加工尺寸图"
Critical: The independent head bottom plate is PROVISIONAL, not user-confirmed. Include its exact label above. No dimensions, fake precision or exploded hardware beyond the described assembly. No large smartphone or desktop feet in this sheet. Head is a whole detachable module after bolted assembly, not an indivisible one-piece print. Maintain strong consistency of the same exterior, visor and colors between assembled and exploded views.
correction_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Edit target Image 1: the orange/yellow cockpit assembly diagram just generated. Preserve its polished assembled head appearance, orange main shell, yellow armor trim, removable transparent multifaceted visor, exploded head shape, Chinese title and overall clean layout. Supporting Image 2: the ACTUAL CAD fixed bowl hood, use this as the structural truth for the LOWER fixed hood, disregarding its gray color.
Make a targeted engineering correction ONLY to the fixed lower docking hood and connector relationship in the right exploded view and bottom-right inset:
1. The fixed lower "碗底" is NOT an upward-open tray. It is a hollow INVERTED cover / downward-open hood: SOLID CLOSED UPPER ROOF, side skirt downwards, hollow underside. Its top surface must be broad and closed like actual CAD reference image2. Two deep screw access HOLES run from that roof down to low bearing bosses. On the roof, a shallow raised rounded-square locating rim surrounds the mating area, and a small CENTERED recess seats a compact 4-contact magnetic connector. The connector contact face points UP. In upper-right exploded view show this orange fixed hood from ABOVE so the closed roof is clearly visible with two small access holes, shallow locating rim and centered magnetic connector.
2. Head bottom plate ABOVE the fixed hood is a separate provisional orange component bolted ONLY to the head cover. Its UNDERSIDE has a female recess fitting the fixed hood locating rim, and its matching magnetic connector faces DOWN. Do not add wires or screws bridging from this removable head plate to the fixed hood.
3. Redraw the bottom-right inset as a clean side CUTAWAY showing head bottom female recessed docking surface hovering above the fixed hood's male locating rim on its CLOSED ROOF. Connector mating faces are horizontal and opposing: upper connector DOWN, lower connector UP. Both are recessed into their OWN respective plastic surfaces. No connector mounted vertically on the inner floor of a tray. NO continuous cable bridging the detachable gap. Three short signal wires may be visible confined INSIDE EACH module, fourth contact unused. Head lifts freely upward with no latch.
4. Update callout "固定碗底｜两颗原机螺丝" to point to that fixed inverted hood; preserve "头部底板｜方案待确认". Use the original short labels "底部配合凹槽", "磁吸接口", "凹凸定位＋磁吸".
5. All visible newly printed shell parts ORANGE or YELLOW. Recolor the visor retaining frame and printed vent slats from black into deep orange or yellow, while purchased camera lens, electronic interior, screws and connector housings may stay dark/metallic. Transparent visor stays transparent smoke-clear, warm amber eyes behind it.
No changes to style or body identity, no legs, no dimensions, no new extra mechanism. This is an assembly concept, not manufacturing CAD. Preserve footer "结构概念示意 · 非加工尺寸图".
